title: Billing-model migration & GTM orchestration: SKU mapping, customer migration, and release notes coordination
creator: Ava Patel
description: Objective: Coordinate cross-functional launch of the new billing model and SKU/limit changes so the public release (pricing-2026.03) is seamless for new signups and minimally disruptive for existing customers. This ticket covers SKU mapping, migration plan, billing communications, release notes, and go-to-market enablement tasks.
acceptance_criteria:
1) All public docs (pricing page, FAQ, release notes) updated and published before deploy window.
2) Billing migration tool tested against staging with a representative sample of accounts and rollback validated.
3) Sales and CS enablement deck and objection-handling FAQ delivered and distributed.
4) Automated billing emails prepared with variable templates; edge-cases covered (prorations, credits, grandfathered SKUs).
5) Telemetry and dashboards (cost per token, conversions, refunds) available in Console by +24h after rollout.
6) Legal sign-off obtained on T&Cs and billing language.
7) No P0 regressions in billing pipelines for 72h post-rollout.
tasks: Finalize SKU mapping spreadsheet and canonical mapping file (s3://redwood-pricing/skus/2026-03-mapping.csv)
Implement and test billing migration jobs in staging (ENG owner: Lina Chen)
Prepare release-notes draft and structured output examples for SDKs (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/421)
Coordinate legal review for updated terms and subscription language (owner: Priya Singh)
Create sales enablement playbook and objection FAQ (owner: SalesOps - Jake Morales)
Prepare customer email templates and segmentation for phased rollout (owner: Growth - Maya Liu)
Update pricing page and support KB articles; schedule content freeze and publish window
Add feature flags and canary gating in runtime for new quota enforcement (ENG-ops task)
Run migration dry-run against 100 representative accounts and document outcomes
Create rollout runbook with rollback steps, cutover window, and monitoring checklist
